EVENT SLEEP mode=ULP gpio=[#F,#R] net=none dur=# -> err=# pin=#
EVENT SLEEP mode=ULP gpio=[#F,#R] net=none dur=# -> err=-# pin=#
EVENT TEARDOWN req=# eff=# force=# err=#
EVENT TRANSITION # sleep-all-attempts-failed
EVENT WATCHDOG pause hibernate
EVENT WATCHDOG pause ulp
EVENT WATCHDOG restore hibernate
EVENT WATCHDOG restore ulp
